sentences.text_target: The winter weather was very cold this week.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪntər ˈwɛðər wəz ˈvɛri koʊld ðɪs wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Le temps hivernal était très froid cette semaine.

sentences.text_target: David unfortunately caught a bad flu.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd ʌnˈfɔrtʃənətli kɔt ə bæd fluː/
sentences.text_native: David a malheureusement attrapé une mauvaise grippe.

sentences.text_target: His symptoms became much worse during the night.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈsɪmptəmz bɪˈkeɪm mʌtʃ wɜrs ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə naɪt/
sentences.text_native: Ses symptômes ont empiré pendant la nuit.

sentences.text_target: He could not sleep because of heavy sweats.
sentences.phonetic: /hi kʊd nɑt sliːp bɪˈkəz ʌv ˈhɛvi swɛts/
sentences.text_native: Il ne pouvait pas dormir à cause de sueurs abondantes.

sentences.text_target: Sudden chills shook his entire body.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdən tʃɪlz ʃʊk hɪz ɪnˈtaɪər ˈbɑdi/
sentences.text_native: Des frissons soudains secouaient tout son corps.

sentences.text_target: All his muscles and joints started to ache.
sentences.phonetic: /ɔl hɪz ˈmʌsəlz ænd dʒɔɪnts ˈstɑrtɪd tu eɪk/
sentences.text_native: Tous ses muscles et ses articulations ont commencé à le faire souffrir.

sentences.text_target: He felt too weak to get out of bed.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fɛlt tu wiːk tu gɛt aʊt ʌv bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Il se sentait trop faible pour sortir du lit.

sentences.text_target: David tried to find his phone on the table.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd traɪd tu faɪnd hɪz foʊn ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
sentences.text_native: David a essayé de trouver son téléphone sur la table.

sentences.text_target: He wrote a quick message to his boss.
sentences.phonetic: /hi roʊt ə kwɪk ˈmɛsɪdʒ tu hɪz bɑs/
sentences.text_native: Il a écrit un message rapide à son patron.

sentences.text_target: He explained his unexpected absence for today.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɪkˈspleɪnd hɪz ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ˈæbsəns fər təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il a expliqué son absence imprévue pour la journée.

sentences.text_target: His head hurt badly when he looked at the screen.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɛd hɜrt ˈbædli wɛn hi lʊkt æt ðə skriːn/
sentences.text_native: Sa tête lui faisait très mal quand il regardait l'écran.

sentences.text_target: He decided to call a local medical clinic.
sentences.phonetic: /hi dɪˈsaɪdɪd tu kɔl ə ˈloʊkəl ˈmɛdɪkəl ˈklɪnɪk/
sentences.text_native: Il a décidé d'appeler une clinique médicale locale.

sentences.text_target: The receptionist scheduled an urgent appointment.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst ˈskɛdʒʊld ən ˈɜrdʒənt əˈpɔɪntmənt/
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste a planifié un rendez-vous urgent.

sentences.text_target: He dressed very slowly and wore a warm coat.
sentences.phonetic: /hi drɛst ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli ænd wɔr ə wɔrm koʊt/
sentences.text_native: Il s'est habillé très lentement et a enfilé un manteau chaud.

sentences.text_target: The walk outside made him shiver again.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə wɔk ˈaʊtsaɪd meɪd hɪm ˈʃɪvər əˈɡɛn/
sentences.text_native: La marche dehors l'a fait frissonner à nouveau.

sentences.text_target: When he arrived, he sat in the quiet waiting room.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn hi əˈraɪvd, hi sæt ɪn ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈweɪtɪŋ rum/
sentences.text_native: Quand il est arrivé, il s'est assis dans la salle d'attente calme.

sentences.text_target: A friendly nurse called his name after twenty minutes.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli nɜrs kɔld hɪz neɪm ˈæftər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
sentences.text_native: Une infirmière aimable a prononcé son nom après vingt minutes.

sentences.text_target: The doctor welcomed him inside the office.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑktər ˈwɛlkəmd hɪm ɪnˈsaɪd ði ˈɔfɪs/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin l'a fait entrer dans son bureau.

sentences.text_target: David described every single painful symptom.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd dɪˈskraɪbd ˈɛvəri ˈsɪŋgəl ˈpeɪnfəl ˈsɪmptəm/
sentences.text_native: David a décrit chaque symptôme douloureux.

sentences.text_target: The physician checked his temperature with a thermometer.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fɪˈzɪʃən tʃɛkt hɪz ˈtɛmprətʃər wɪð ə θərˈmɑmətər/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a pris sa température avec un thermomètre.

sentences.text_target: The high fever was confirmed immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə haɪ ˈfivər wəz kənˈfɜrmd ɪˈmidiətli/
sentences.text_native: La forte fièvre a été confirmée immédiatement.

sentences.text_target: He listened carefully to David's chest and lungs.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈlɪsənd ˈkɛrfuli tu ˈdeɪvɪdz tʃɛst ænd lʌŋz/
sentences.text_native: Il a ausculté attentivement la poitrine et les poumons de David.

sentences.text_target: He confirmed it was a serious respiratory infection.
sentences.phonetic: /hi kənˈfɜrmd ɪt wəz ə ˈsɪriəs ˈrɛspərətɔri ɪnˈfɛkʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il a confirmé qu'il s'agissait d'une infection respiratoire grave.

sentences.text_target: The doctor wrote a professional prescription on paper.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑktər roʊt ə prəˈfɛʃənəl prɪˈskrɪpʃən ɑn ˈpeɪpər/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin a rédigé une ordonnance sur papier.

sentences.text_target: David walked slowly to the local pharmacy.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdeɪvɪd wɔkt ˈsloʊli tu ðə ˈloʊkəl ˈfɑrməsi/
sentences.text_native: David a marché lentement jusqu'à la pharmacie du quartier.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist gave him strong medicine and syrup.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑrməsɪst geɪv hɪm strɔŋ ˈmɛdɪsɪn ænd ˈsɪrəp/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien lui a délivré des médicaments puissants et du sirop.

sentences.text_target: He returned home and drank a hot glass of water.
sentences.phonetic: /hi rɪˈtɜrnd hoʊm ænd dræŋk ə hɑt glæs ʌv ˈwɔtər/
sentences.text_native: Il est rentré chez lui et a bu un verre d'eau chaude.

sentences.text_target: He pulled the thick blanket over his body.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊld ðə θɪk ˈblæŋkɪt ˈoʊvər hɪz ˈbɑdi/
sentences.text_native: Il a tiré une épaisse couverture sur son corps.

sentences.text_target: Good rest and proper care helped him recover.
sentences.phonetic: /gʊd rɛst ænd ˈprɑpər kɛr hɛlpt hɪm rɪˈkʌvər/
sentences.text_native: Un bon repos et des soins appropriés l'ont aidé à guérir.

sentences.text_target: His health returned to normal after a few days.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɛlθ rɪˈtɜrnd tu ˈnɔrməl ˈæftər ə fjuː deɪz/
sentences.text_native: Sa santé est redevenue normale après quelques jours.
